content.comment_body: Hello, Please refer to the attached [document]. Is the power supply I selected sufficient for the IO module? How do you determine this? Does the [company_name] selection tool have a feature for this? Thanks.
You have to make the decision yourself. It's necessary to know which load will be connected to the power supply.
I understand. Should I only consider the external loads? Thanks.
You can find the power consumption details for the basic module and expansion modules in the manual under the technical data section.
The technical data includes different types of current information. Which specific value should I focus on? Thank you.

Please provide more details about your project. Specify the power supply voltage (12V, 24V, or 230V), the number of base modules and expansion units, what is connected to the outputs, whether power relays are used, and what is used on the inputs. We need additional information to assist further.

analysis.insight_summary: The user requested advice on verifying if their chosen power supply is compatible with an IO module and asked whether the [company_name] selection tool could automate this process. Replies indicated the need for manual calculations based on module documentation, especially technical data on current requirements, resulting in confusion about which values to consider. The discussion highlights a lack of streamlined guidance or tool-based assistance during setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates clear instructions or automated guidance from a tool to help determine the appropriate power supply for IO modules, rather than relying solely on manual evaluation of technical specifications.
